sentences.en: So it sees the West as disrupting other governments, so it's just answering back.
sentences.zh: 他实际上提到了“阿拉伯之春”，认为还有更多能够影响政府的事情正在发生。

sentences.en: In early 2013, a very senior Russian general, General Gerasimov, writes in a military journal about a whole new idea about war.
sentences.zh: 不仅是传统的军事硬件能够给社会带来巨大的破坏，还有不同形式的战争。

sentences.en: And he actually refers to the Arab Spring, that there's just a lot more going on that can affect the government.
sentences.zh: 因此他提出，俄罗斯应该开始考虑通过政治、经济等手段发动战争

sentences.en: And it's not just classic military hardware that can cause huge disruption in the society, that there are different forms of war.
sentences.zh: 来达成目标。

sentences.en: So what he proposes is that Russia starts thinking about waging war through political, economic,
sentences.zh: （此条多余，略过或按规则留空，但由于键必须完整，补全为对应最后一句结尾或自然收尾）

sentences.en: and informational means that tap into, quote-unquote, the protest potential of the population.
sentences.zh: 而信息手段利用的是所谓的人群“抗议潜力”。

sentences.en: The idea of this becomes known as the Gerasimov Doctrine, it becomes known as hybrid war.
sentences.zh: 这种理念后来被称为“格拉西莫夫主义”，也被称为混合战。

sentences.en: And the Russian military doctrine gets changed to take this into account.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯的军事学说也进行了修改以将这一点考虑进去。

sentences.en: Information is part of war.
sentences.zh: 信息是战争的一部分。

sentences.en: Its aggressive use is part of war.
sentences.zh: 其攻击性运用是战争的一部分。

sentences.en: And where does RT fit into that?
sentences.zh: 那么RT在其中扮演什么角色呢？

sentences.en: Well, so this is where, when RT comes along in more recent years, you have all these governments,
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是近年来RT出现时，你会听到所有这些政府——

sentences.en: including ours, basically saying it's part of a hybrid war sort of strategy to disrupt the political balance of the countries where it's operating.
sentences.zh: 包括我们自己的政府，基本上都在说它是混合战战略的一部分，旨在破坏其运营所在国的政治平衡。

sentences.en: If you have any doubt at all that Hillary Clinton is the Illuminati's candidate, then just take a look at this logo.
sentences.zh: 如果你对希拉里·克林顿是否是光照派候选人有任何怀疑，那就看看这个标志吧。

sentences.en: Well, that would seem to bring us to 2016 and the election.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这似乎把我们带到了2016年和那场选举。

sentences.en: And we're talking about all this and we care about all this because of what happened in last year's election
sentences.zh: 我们之所以讨论所有这些并且关心所有这些，是因为去年大选中发生的事情

sentences.en: and our deep discomfort around Russia's involvement in our electoral system.
sentences.zh: 以及我们对俄罗斯介入我们选举系统深感不安。

sentences.en: You might have heard that the FBI is investigating the cyber attack on the Democratic National Committee, or DNC, that resulted in a massive email leak.
sentences.zh: 你可能听说过联邦调查局正在调查针对民主党全国委员会（即DNC）的网络攻击，该攻击导致了大量电子邮件泄露。

sentences.en: Well, so there was a declassified intelligence report that came out in January about the election.
sentences.zh: 嗯，今年1月发布了一份关于选举的解密情报报告。

sentences.en: And half of that report almost was about RT.
sentences.zh: 而那份报告几乎有一半是关于RT的。

sentences.en: If you did hear about it, you probably heard that the FBI is investigating Clinton's claim that the Russians are behind the hack.
sentences.zh: 如果你听说过此事，你可能也听说联邦调查局正在调查克林顿的说法，即俄罗斯人是黑客事件的幕后黑手。

sentences.en: In part, that's because RT is the public part of this.
sentences.zh: 部分原因在于，RT是这其中公开的一面。

sentences.en: It's what you can discuss.
sentences.zh: 这是你可以拿来讨论的。

sentences.en: It's out in the open.
sentences.zh: 它是公开透明的。

sentences.en: That's the amazing thing.
sentences.zh: 这就是神奇的地方。

sentences.en: But you probably didn't hear about another incident around the DNC that is being investigated, too, which is this.
sentences.zh: 但你可能没有听说过DNC周围另一起也在调查中的事件，就是这个。

sentences.en: A DNC staffer was mysteriously murdered in the middle of the night and police have no leads.
sentences.zh: 一名DNC工作人员在半夜离奇遇害，警方没有任何线索。

sentences.en: Instead, they're only reporting Clinton says Russia did it.
sentences.zh: 相反，他们只报道克林顿说这是俄罗斯干的。

sentences.en: Now, I am certainly not saying that Rich was the leaker and that Clinton stole out of the middle of the night and shot him herself.
sentences.zh: 现在，我当然不是说里奇是泄密者，也不是说克林顿在半夜溜出来亲自枪杀了他。

sentences.en: Not at all.
sentences.zh: 完全不是这个意思。

sentences.en: I'm just saying when I only hear one narrative being told by our media and it's all speculative
sentences.zh: 我只是想说，当我只听到我们的媒体在讲一种完全出于推测的叙事

sentences.en: and I see another very real narrative not being told, I tend to come to one conclusion.
sentences.zh: 而另一个非常真实的叙事却无人提及，我往往会得出一个结论。

sentences.en: Our media sure sucks at investigating, whether it's intentional or not.
sentences.zh: 我们的媒体在调查方面确实逊毙了，不管是故意还是无意。

sentences.en: Basically, without quite putting it this way, what the U.S.
sentences.zh: 基本上，虽然没有直接这样明说，但美国

sentences.en: intelligence community is saying is that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 情报界所表达的意思是，美国

sentences.en: was the victim of a hybrid war attack.
sentences.zh: 是混合战攻击的受害者。

sentences.en: Jim, do you think that Margarita, who you spent a lot of time with in Russia, do you think she entirely understands her own role in all of this?
sentences.zh: 吉姆，你认为玛格丽塔——你在俄罗斯和她相处了很长时间——你认为她完全理解自己在这一切中所扮演的角色吗？

sentences.en: This is like this kind of bright-eyed Russian reporter who spent time in the U.S.,
sentences.zh: 这就好比这位眼神明亮的俄罗斯记者曾在美国待过，

sentences.en: was plucked into this job.
sentences.zh: 然后被选中担任这个职位。

sentences.en: Do you think she understands that she has become a part of such a – in the American eyes, essentially a conspiracy to disrupt our democratic system?
sentences.zh: 你认为她是否明白，在美方眼中，她本质上已经成为破坏我们民主制度的阴谋的一部分？

sentences.en: First of all, she is super sophisticated, very smart operator.
sentences.zh: 首先，她非常老练，是一个极其聪明的操盘手。

sentences.en: She told me, you know, this is ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 她对我说，你知道，这太荒谬了。

sentences.en: You know, I'm not – what do you mean I'm part of a weapon?
sentences.zh: 你知道，我不是——你什么意思，我是武器的一部分？

sentences.en: But anyway, for me, I'm a very peaceful person.
sentences.zh: 但无论如何，对我来说，我是一个非常爱好和平的人。

sentences.en: You know, I have two children and I'm very, very peaceful.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我有两个孩子，我非常非常爱好和平。

sentences.en: I don't like wars anymore.
sentences.zh: 我再也不喜欢战争了。

sentences.en: That this is hysteria, that it's bordering on McCarthyism, that they're a news organization, and just because Western media doesn't like them
sentences.zh: 她认为这是一种歇斯底里，近乎麦卡锡主义，他们是一个新闻机构，只因西方媒体不喜欢他们

sentences.en: and thinks – and is a threat to them, she would imply, right, that they just don't want them in the mix.
sentences.zh: 并且认为——对他们构成了威胁，她会暗示，对吧，他们只是不想让他们搅和进来。

sentences.en: When I brought up the Seth Rich – a Seth Rich example, she effectively says, what about Fox News?
sentences.zh: 当我提起塞思·里奇——塞思·里奇这个例子时，她反问道：那福克斯新闻呢？

sentences.en: Also tonight, another massive breaking news story.
sentences.zh: 同样在今晚，又有一则重磅突发新闻。

sentences.en: Explosive developments in the mysterious murder of former DNC staffer Seth Rich.
sentences.zh: 前DNC工作人员塞思·里奇离奇遇害案有了爆炸性进展。

sentences.en: Why aren't you picking on them?
sentences.zh: 你们为什么不找他们的麻烦？

sentences.en: So, you know, that's her viewpoint.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，这就是她的观点。

sentences.en: And, you know, by the way, you can say, yeah, Fox is – or Sean Hannity has done some of the same things.
sentences.zh: 而且，顺便说一句，你可以说，是的，福克斯——或者肖恩·汉尼提也做过一些类似的事情。

sentences.en: If this is true, and Seth Rich gave WikiLeaks these DNC emails, which ultimately led to the firing.
sentences.zh: 如果这是真的，塞思·里奇将DNC的这些电子邮件交给了维基解密，这最终导致了开除。

sentences.en: Remember Debbie Wasserman Schultz on the eve of the DNC convention?
sentences.zh: 还记得在DNC大会前夕的黛比·沃瑟曼·舒尔茨吗？

sentences.en: This blows the whole Russia collusion narrative completely out of the water.
sentences.zh: 这彻底粉碎了俄罗斯勾结的说法。

sentences.en: Now, maybe Seth Rich was upset that the DNC was –
sentences.zh: 现在，也许塞思·里奇对DNC感到不满——

sentences.en: And not to put you back into that restaurant in Russia again, but Fox News takes a pretty clear editorial agenda too.
sentences.zh: 无意再次把你带回俄罗斯的那家餐厅，但福克斯新闻也有着非常明确的编辑议程。

sentences.en: So does MSNBC.
sentences.zh: MSNBC也是如此。

sentences.en: Yeah, and none of this would work.
sentences.zh: 是的，而且这一切都不会起作用。

sentences.en: And to me, this is the biggest deal.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这才是最重要的问题。

sentences.en: No one would be worried about RT if RT wasn't finding an American audience that is interested in its content.
sentences.zh: 如果RT没有找到对其次感兴趣的美国受众，没有人会担心RT。

sentences.en: And it is.
sentences.zh: 事实确实如此。

sentences.en: It's found its audience.
sentences.zh: 它已经找到了它的受众。

sentences.en: And that audience that you're describing is people open to perspectives on the fringes.
sentences.zh: 你所描述的那群受众，是对边缘观点持开放态度的人。

sentences.en: Yeah, or people open to perspectives who aren't – are distrustful of the mainstream and feel like their own views are undercovered elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 是的，或者是对那些不信任主流、觉得自己观点在别处报道不足的观点持开放态度的人。

sentences.en: Isn't that more or less exactly what we're dealing with here in the United States with our own media right now?
sentences.zh: 这不正是我们现在在美国国内通过我们自己的媒体所面对的情况吗？

sentences.en: Breitbart, Alex Jones, people who are appealing to Americans
sentences.zh: 布赖特巴特新闻网、亚历克斯·琼斯，这些吸引美国人的声音

sentences.en: who distrust, who feel alienated, and feel completely left out of the mainstream.
sentences.zh: 他们心存不信任，感到被疏离，并觉得被主流完全抛弃了。

sentences.en: Yeah, they are in a chorus.
sentences.zh: 是的，他们形成了一种合唱。

sentences.en: We've talked a lot about them being part of a Russian media world, but they've also tapped in and connected with an American part of the world – of the media world that, you know,
sentences.zh: 我们讨论了很多关于他们是俄罗斯媒体世界一部分的内容，但他们也已经接入并连接了美国媒体世界的一部分——你知道的，

sentences.en: some people have called alt-right.
sentences.zh: 有些人称之为另类右翼。

sentences.en: You've got the Alex Jones conspiracy types.
sentences.zh: 你拥有亚历克斯·琼斯那种阴谋论类型的人。

sentences.en: You can see where their –
sentences.zh: 你可以看出他们的——

sentences.en: RT's coverage floats around with these other sources, and they sort of are part of that same quadrant of media.
sentences.zh: RT的报道与这些其他来源不谋而合，他们某种程度上属于媒体的同一个象限。

sentences.en: Madam Undersecretary, ladies and gentlemen,
sentences.zh: 副部长女士，女士们先生们，

sentences.en: this is probably the only chance I will ever have to give a speech in the United Nations building.
sentences.zh: 这可能是我唯一一次有机会在联合国大楼发表演讲。

sentences.en: So back to that party at the UN in January, which is where we started, and it looks to me like this was a moment when the international community deemed RT acceptable.
sentences.zh: 回到1月份在联合国的那场派对，也就是我们开始的地方，在我看来，这是国际社会认为RT可以接受的一个时刻。

sentences.en: So what has happened from that time, which wasn't that long ago, to today?
sentences.zh: 那么从那个并不算太久以前的时间点到今天，发生了什么变化呢？

sentences.en: So, you know, when I first start reporting this story, it's in person.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，当我开始报道这个故事时，我是亲自去的。

sentences.en: I'm at the UN, and it's just this great moment for RT.
sentences.zh: 我在联合国，对RT来说，这真是一个伟大的时刻。

sentences.en: It's gotten everything it wanted.
sentences.zh: 它得到了它想要的一切。

sentences.en: It's got the international recognition.
sentences.zh: 它获得了国际认可。

sentences.en: It's alongside BBC World and CNN International.
sentences.zh: 它与BBC世界新闻频道和CNN国际新闻频道并驾齐驱。

sentences.en: People must have the right to know different news coming from different sources, and then make their own judgment.
sentences.zh: 人们必须有权了解来自不同来源的不同新闻，然后做出他们自己的判断。

sentences.en: And now here we are in September, and just the last few days, you see the other side of that coin.
sentences.zh: 现在我们来到了9月，就在过去几天里，你看到了硬币的另一面。

sentences.en: The FBI is now bearing down on Russia-backed entities inside the U.S., like RT and Sputnik.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局现在正在向美国国内支持俄罗斯的实体施压，例如RT和卫星通讯社。

sentences.en: And until this week, government scrutiny on them came mostly from U.S.
sentences.zh: 直到本周，政府对它们的审查主要来自美国

sentences.en: intelligence agencies looking abroad, like the report on Russian meddling, listing Sputnik as a Russian propaganda effort, serving as a platform for Kremlin messaging
sentences.zh: 驻外情报机构，例如关于俄罗斯干预的报告，将卫星通讯社列为俄罗斯的宣传机构，作为克列姆林宫向

sentences.en: to Russian and international audiences.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯和国际受众传递信息的平台。

sentences.en: So it's the opposite of being treated like a news organization.
sentences.zh: 所以这与被当成新闻机构对待恰恰相反。

sentences.en: This is treating it as a weapon of war.
sentences.zh: 这是把它当成战争武器来对待。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们去去就回。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: In the Florida Keys, where Hurricane Irma damaged nearly every house, the Times visited the homes of residents who refused to leave.
sentences.zh: 在佛罗里达群岛，飓风“厄玛”破坏了几乎每一栋房屋，《时报》走访了那些拒绝撤离的居民的家。

sentences.en: There's nothing left for us.
sentences.zh: 我们什么都不剩了。

sentences.en: We just got here this morning to check.
sentences.zh: 我们今天早上才刚到这儿来看看。

sentences.en: I had to climb through that window to get in.
sentences.zh: 我不得不从那个窗户爬进去。

sentences.en: And everything that wasn't packed in my truck is gone.
sentences.zh: 所有没有装进我卡车里的东西都没了。

sentences.en: I saved a cheSt.
sentences.zh: 我保住了一个箱子。

sentences.en: That I've been putting stuff in ever since I was a little kid.
sentences.zh: 那是我从小到大一直用来放东西的箱子。

sentences.en: Pictures of my mom.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈的照片。

sentences.en: You know, baseball cards and stuff to pass to my son.
sentences.zh: 你知道，还有棒球卡之类的东西，打算传给我儿子。

sentences.en: But you know, it's part of living here.
sentences.zh: 但你知道，这是住在这里的一部分。

sentences.en: You save what you can and Mother Nature takes the reSt.
sentences.zh: 你能保住多少就保住多少，剩下的就交给大自然。

sentences.en: Millions remain without power in Florida.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达州仍有数百万人断电。

sentences.en: And Jacksonville in particular is dealing with serious and unexpected flooding.
sentences.zh: 杰克逊维尔尤其正在应对严重且意料之外的洪水。

sentences.en: At least 55 people have died as a result of the storm, which is now a post-tropical cyclone moving toward Tennessee.
sentences.zh: 这场风暴已造成至少55人死亡，目前已变成后热带气旋，正向田纳西州移动。

sentences.en: And
sentences.zh: 而且

sentences.en: It's like there's a huge love affair between me and the whole gay community.
sentences.zh: 就好像我和整个同性恋群体之间有着一场巨大的热恋。

sentences.en: And I can't walk down the street without people stopping me to say thank you.
sentences.zh: 我走在街上，总有人拦住我对我说谢谢。

sentences.en: It's thrilling.
sentences.zh: 这太令人激动了。

sentences.en: Edith Windsor, whose same-sex marriage fight led to a landmark ruling, has died at the age of 88.
sentences.zh: 伊迪丝·温莎，其同性婚姻之争促成了一项具有里程碑意义的裁决，享年88岁逝世。

sentences.en: Windsor just wanted a tax refund from the IRS after the death of her longtime partner,
sentences.zh: 在长期伴侣西娅·斯派尔去世后，温莎只是想要国税局退税。

sentences.en: Thea Spire.
sentences.zh: 西娅·斯派尔。

sentences.en: Three years later, that fight over federal benefits reached the Supreme Court, which ruled in her favor, striking down the Defense of Marriage Act and paving the way
sentences.zh: 三年后，这场关于联邦福利的争端闹到了最高法院，最高法院做出了对她有利的裁决，推翻了《婚姻防御法案》，并为

sentences.en: for the legalization of same-sex marriage in 2015.
sentences.zh: 2015年同性婚姻合法化铺平了道路。

sentences.en: Windsor spoke to John Hockenberry on the takeaway after the ruling.
sentences.zh: 裁决做出后，温莎在《要点》节目中接受了约翰·霍肯贝里的采访。

sentences.en: Was Thea there in court?
sentences.zh: 西娅当时在法庭上吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对在。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对在。

sentences.en: You know, people ask that and I thought, what a silly question.
sentences.zh: 你知道，人们会问这个问题，当时我想，这算什么傻问题。

sentences.en: But yes, yes, she was.
sentences.zh: 但没错，是的，她在。

sentences.en: Actually, I find notes from time to time.
sentences.zh: 实际上，我时不时会找到一些便条。

sentences.en: I find various things in drawers all over that in the apartment.
sentences.zh: 我在公寓各处的抽屉里发现了各种各样的东西。

sentences.en: And I came home and I swear to you that it was the day that of the oral arguments at the Supreme Court that I found a note that said, you did it, honey.
sentences.zh: 我回到家，我向你发誓，就在最高法院进行口头辩论的那天，我发现了一张便条，上面写着：“亲爱的，你做到了。”

sentences.en: Congratulations.
sentences.zh: 祝贺你。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: From her.
sentences.zh: 来自她。

sentences.en: Now, she hadn't been able to write for years.
sentences.zh: 现在，她已经好几年无法书写了。

sentences.en: So I assume it was probably something like when I stopped smoking.
sentences.zh: 所以我猜这可能类似于我戒烟时那种情况。

sentences.en: But I thought, I was spooked.
sentences.zh: 但我当时想，我被吓到了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: I have this note.
sentences.zh: 我留着这张便条。

sentences.en: And she's still talking to you, right?
sentences.zh: 她还在跟你说话，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I think she would be thrilled.
sentences.zh: 我想她会欣喜若狂的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《导购秀》节目中，我们将为筹办节日聚会做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目获取让客人们宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种一觉睡到天黑的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean, do they black out to go to sleep?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们睡觉时需要完全黑暗吗？

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这非常具体。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 请在《纽约时报》App 或您喜欢的任何地方收听 The Wirecutter Show。
